description: Copper is a platform that provides a RESTful web API enabling developers to programmatically access its resources and build custom applications.

buildability.blocker: Requires admin approval to obtain credentials.

evidence.claim: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.
To generate an API token, in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY' button.
The Dev API uses token based authentication.
You have to include the token in the header of every request, along with the email address of the user who generated the token.
Users can hold multiple valid tokens at the same time.
Admins can see all user generated tokens and generate new ones.
A service account is a non-personal account used to manage API keys for automated or shared operations.
Copper provides a public documented API
The Copper Developer API is a RESTful interface
API keys generated in system settings
Only admin users can generate API keys
